attributes.action: Protect Bonfire Night and the Right to Enjoy Fireworks Responsibly at Home
attributes.additional_details:
Fireworks are not simply entertainment, they are part of a long-established British cultural tradition. For many, childhood memories are of standing in the garden with family and friends watching fireworks and lighting sparklers.

Whilst firework misuse causes distress and should be addressed, there is a danger that progressively restricting the fireworks available to the public could move Bonfire Night away from a living community tradition to exclusively professional events.
attributes.background: Fireworks are a cherished British Bonfire Night tradition. We ask the Government to 1) Protect the continued sale and responsible use of consumer fireworks suitable for traditional home displays 2) Avoid imposing noise restrictions that unnecessarily remove fireworks from the consumer market

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on maintaining the current rules and regulations around fireworks to allow their use. You may wish to sign it:

Maintain current regulations to allow public firework use to continue
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786774
